Name: (CP) More Accessible Stardrop Tea
Author: murtah5155
Description:
As of right now, there are three new ways to unlock Stardrop Tea
1. Mr. Qi will sell Stardrop Tea for 40 Qi Gems in the Walnut Room 
2. Upon helping the Raccoons 6 times and having the Foraging Mastery (the same requirements as Magic Rock Candy), the Raccoon Wife will sell Stardrop Tea for 30 Golden Mystery Boxes
3. You can trade 1 Book of Stars at the Bookseller for Stardrop Tea (@Hanzo12138)

Please lmk of any more avenues for making Stardrop Tea more accessible or lmk if these are too broken.
